title: RAG Knowledge Base (Aurora)
description: A full-stack RAG application that enables intelligent document interactions.
fulldescription: This prototype builds a powerful search-and-answer system using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). It uses Amazon Bedrock Agents to understand questions and a Knowledge Base to find answers in your documents. The documents are stored in Amazon Aurora, a high-performance database that acts as a vector store to find the most relevant information using logical comparisons. It includes a chat interface where you can upload files to S3, sync them to the database, and ask questions immediately.

services.name: Amazon Bedrock
services.desc: Orchestrates the agent and manages the Knowledge Base for document retrieval.

services.name: Amazon Aurora
services.desc: A relational database running in Serverless mode to store document vectors.

services.name: S3
services.desc: Stores the source documents (PDFs, text files) for the Knowledge Base.

services.name: Lambda
services.desc: Handles database initialization and connects the API to the Agent.

services.name: Amazon DynamoDB
services.desc: Stores chat logs and conversation history.

services.name: API Gateway
services.desc: Provides the secure endpoint for the chat interface.
